queryCounts.label: static
queryCounts.scope: Untimed actual rayQueryInitializeEXT executions in diffuse/leaf diffuse passes. Query initializations are not hardware BVH/triangle tests or traversal iterations. Private invocation counters do not alter RNG, ray arguments or radiance expressions. Instrumented pipeline/register pressure, counter memory, asynchronous copies, CPU sums and I/O exclude this capture from performance and baseline VRAM claims. Other renderer passes are not counted.

laneSemantics.continuationRadiance: Subsequent actual diffuse segment queries; includes only executed path continuation
laneSemantics.emissiveVisibility: Closest-hit emitter visibility queries after proposal early rejection; not attempted proposals
laneSemantics.primaryRadiance: Queries launched by the receiver's diffuse samples; zero for rejected/background pixels
laneSemantics.solarVisibility: All actual solar visibility queries, including separate solid preflight and leaf-interface enumeration where reached
